  title: "MAG recovery report"
  results_dir: ""
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 120)
library(magreport)
run <- params$run
has <- function(x) !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0
studies <- attr(run, "studies")
multi <- length(studies) > 1
```

Report generated from `` `r params$results_dir` `` with the
[magreport](https://github.com/AntonioPuriel/magreport) R package.

## Summary

```{r summary}
lines <- character()

if (has(run$mapping)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **Samples:** %d", nrow(run$mapping)))
}
if (has(run$assembly) && !multi) {
  # The contigs kept after length filtering: the last row of each assembly
  kept <- run$assembly[!duplicated(run$assembly$assembly, fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(kept) == 1) {
    lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
      "- **Assembly:** %s contigs, %.1f Mb, N50 %s bp",
      format(kept$n_contigs, big.mark = ","),
      kept$total_length / 1e6,
      format(kept$n50, big.mark = ",")
    ))
  } else {
    lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
      "- **Assemblies:** %d, with %s contigs and %s in all, N50 from %s to %s bp",
      nrow(kept),
      format(sum(kept$n_contigs), big.mark = ","),
      if (sum(kept$total_length) >= 1e9) sprintf("%.1f Gb", sum(kept$total_length) / 1e9) else
        sprintf("%.1f Mb", sum(kept$total_length) / 1e6),
      format(min(kept$n50), big.mark = ","),
      format(max(kept$n50), big.mark = ",")
    ))
  }
}
if (has(run$bins)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **Bins:** %d from %s",
                            nrow(run$bins),
                            paste(sort(unique(run$bins$binner)), collapse = ", ")))
}
if (has(run$mags)) {
  counts <- count_quality(run$mags)
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
    "- **MAGs assessed:** %d (%s)",
    nrow(run$mags),
    paste(sprintf("%d %s", counts$n, counts$quality), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}
if (has(run$catalog)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
    "- **Gene catalog:** %s non-redundant genes from %s genes called",
    format(run$catalog$catalog_genes, big.mark = ","),
    format(run$catalog$genes_called, big.mark = ",")
  ))
}
if (has(run$singlem)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **SingleM:** profiles of %d samples from the reads",
                            length(unique(run$singlem$sample))))
}

knitr::asis_output(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r studies, eval = multi}
knitr::kable(
  summarise_studies(run), row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Study", "Pipeline", "Samples", "Bins", "High", "Medium", "Low", "GUNC fail"),
  caption = paste("Studies. MAGs per quality: the dereplicated genomes (MIMAG) when",
                  "the study has them, else every bin assessed by CheckM2")
)
```

## Chimeras (GUNC)

```{r gunc-setup, include = FALSE}
gunc_mags <- if (has(run$mags)) run$mags else run$mimag
```

```{r gunc-plot, eval = has(run$gunc)}
suppressWarnings(plot_gunc(run$gunc, mags = gunc_mags))
```

```{r gunc-counts, eval = has(run$gunc)}
counts <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(if (multi) paste(run$gunc$study, run$gunc$assembly) else run$gunc$assembly, factor(run$gunc$pass, c(TRUE, FALSE))))
names(counts) <- c("Pass", "Fail")
counts <- cbind(Assembly = rownames(counts), counts)
knitr::kable(counts, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Bins that pass or fail GUNC, per assembly")
```

```{r gunc-hidden, eval = has(run$gunc) && has(gunc_mags) && "quality" %in% names(gunc_mags)}
hidden <- merge(
  gunc_mags[, intersect(c("study", "bin", "completeness", "contamination", "quality"), names(gunc_mags))],
  run$gunc[!run$gunc$pass, c(intersect("study", names(run$gunc)), "bin", "taxonomic_level", "clade_separation_score", "contamination_portion")],
  by = intersect(c("study", "bin"), names(run$gunc))
)
hidden <- hidden[!is.na(hidden$quality) & hidden$quality %in% c("high", "medium"), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(hidden) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output("_Every bin of high or medium CheckM2 quality passes GUNC._")
} else {
  hidden <- hidden[order(-hidden$clade_separation_score), ]
  knitr::kable(
    utils::head(hidden, 25), row.names = FALSE, digits = 2,
    caption = sprintf(paste(
      "%d bins of high or medium CheckM2 quality that GUNC finds chimeric",
      "(up to 25 shown, highest clade separation score first)"), nrow(hidden))
  )
}
```

```{r no-gunc, eval = !has(run$gunc)}
knitr::asis_output("_No GUNC reports found: run the pipeline with --gunc_db._")
```

## Community profile

The whole community, without binning: the genes of every contig gathered in a
non-redundant catalog, with their abundance (TPM) in each sample, their
taxonomy (CAT) and function (eggNOG, CANT-HYD), and the profile of the reads
with SingleM, which needs no assembly.

```{r community-setup, include = FALSE}
has_community <- has(run$catalog) || has(run$profile_stats) ||
  has(run$contig_taxonomy) || has(run$singlem)
n_samples <- length(unique(c(run$contig_taxonomy$sample, run$singlem$sample,
                             run$profile_stats$sample)))
wide <- max(8, 4 + 0.22 * n_samples)
```

```{r catalog, eval = has(run$catalog)}
knitr::kable(run$catalog, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Genes called on the contigs and genes in the catalog")
```

```{r annotation-fraction, eval = has(run$profile_stats)}
plot_annotation_fraction(run$profile_stats)
```

```{r cat-phylum, eval = !multi && has(run$contig_taxonomy), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$contig_taxonomy, rank = "phylum")
```

```{r cat-genus, eval = !multi && has(run$contig_taxonomy), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$contig_taxonomy, rank = "genus", top = 12)
```

```{r singlem-phylum, eval = !multi && has(run$singlem), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$singlem, rank = "phylum")
```

```{r singlem-genus, eval = !multi && has(run$singlem), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$singlem, rank = "genus", top = 12)
```

```{r comparison, eval = !multi && has(run$contig_taxonomy) && has(run$singlem), fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 6}
plot_profile_comparison(run$contig_taxonomy, run$singlem, rank = "phylum")
plot_profile_comparison(run$contig_taxonomy, run$singlem, rank = "genus")
```

```{r recovery-setup, include = FALSE}
# MAGs with taxonomy: the dereplicated set (MIMAG table) if there is one
recovery_mags <- if (has(run$mimag)) run$mimag else run$mags
recovery_profile <- if (has(run$singlem)) run$singlem else run$contig_taxonomy
has_recovery <- has(recovery_mags) && has(recovery_profile) &&
  "phylum" %in% names(recovery_mags) && !all(is.na(recovery_mags$phylum))
recovery <- if (has_recovery) mag_recovery(recovery_profile, recovery_mags)
```

```{r recovery, eval = has_recovery}
knitr::asis_output(paste(
  "### Community represented by the MAGs

",
  "Share of the community in taxa with at least one MAG of medium or high",
  "quality, at each rank. Taxa are matched by their GTDB name, so names that",
  "differ between the GTDB releases of SingleM and GTDB-Tk are missed."
))
```

```{r recovery-plot, eval = has_recovery}
plot_mag_recovery(recovery)
```

```{r recovery-table, eval = has_recovery}
medians <- stats::aggregate(cbind(classified, recovered, recovered_of_classified) ~ rank,
                            data = recovery, FUN = stats::median)
knitr::kable(medians, digits = 1, row.names = FALSE,
             col.names = c("Rank", "Classified (%)", "In taxa with a MAG (%)",
                           "Of the classified (%)"),
             caption = "Median over the samples")
```

```{r community-multi, eval = multi && has_community}
knitr::asis_output(paste(
  "_The composition of each sample is not drawn for several studies at once:",
  "build the report of each study for it._"
))
```

```{r canthyd-heatmap, eval = !multi && has(run$contig_canthyd), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 2 + 0.25 * length(unique(run$contig_canthyd$feature))}
plot_feature_heatmap(run$contig_canthyd, top = 40)
```


## Methods

```{r methods-setup, include = FALSE}
info <- attr(run, "run_info")
methods <- if (!multi && !is.null(info)) describe_run(info)
```

```{r methods-multi, eval = multi}
blocks <- vapply(studies, function(study) {
  one <- info[[study]]
  if (is.null(one)) {
    return(paste0("### ", study, "\n\n_No run information found._\n"))
  }
  d <- describe_run(one)
  paste0(
    "### ", study, "\n\n",
    paste(knitr::kable(d$run, col.names = c("", ""), row.names = FALSE), collapse = "\n"),
    if (nrow(d$databases) > 0) paste0("\n\n", paste(knitr::kable(
      d$databases, col.names = c("Database", "Path", "Last modified"), row.names = FALSE),
      collapse = "\n")) else "",
    if (nrow(d$software) > 0) paste0("\n\n", paste(knitr::kable(
      d$software, col.names = c("Tool", "Version"), row.names = FALSE),
      collapse = "\n")) else "",
    "\n"
  )
}, character(1))
knitr::asis_output(paste(blocks, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r methods-text, eval = !is.null(methods)}
p <- info$params
value <- function(x, default = "-") if (is.null(x)) default else paste(x, collapse = ", ")
dbs <- methods$databases
db_text <- if (nrow(dbs) > 0) {
  paste0(" Reference databases (path, last modified): ",
         paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", dbs$database, ifelse(is.na(dbs$modified), "date unknown", dbs$modified)),
               collapse = "; "), ".")
} else ""
knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "Results produced by mag-pipeline ", value(info$pipeline$version), " (Nextflow ",
  value(info$pipeline$nextflow), ") with assembly mode `", value(p$assembly_mode),
  "`, binners `", value(p$binners), "`", if (isTRUE(p$refine)) " refined with DAS_Tool" else "",
  ", contigs of at least ", value(p$min_contig_length), " bp",
  if (isTRUE(p$dereplicate)) paste0(" and dereplication at ", value(p$derep_ani), " % ANI") else "",
  ".", db_text,
  if (nrow(methods$software) > 0) paste0(" Tools: ",
    paste(sprintf("%s %s", methods$software$tool, methods$software$version), collapse = ", "),
    ".") else "",
  if (is.na(info$schema_version)) " Read from `run_info.txt`." else
    paste0(" Read from `manifest.json` (schema ", info$schema_version, ").")
))
```

```{r methods-run, eval = !is.null(methods)}
knitr::kable(methods$run, col.names = c("", ""), row.names = FALSE, caption = "Run")
```

```{r methods-databases, eval = !is.null(methods) && nrow(methods$databases) > 0}
knitr::kable(methods$databases, col.names = c("Database", "Path", "Last modified"),
             row.names = FALSE, caption = "Reference databases")
```

```{r methods-software, eval = !is.null(methods) && nrow(methods$software) > 0}
knitr::kable(methods$software, col.names = c("Tool", "Version"), row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Versions of the tools, as each tool reported it during the run")
```

```{r methods-params, eval = !is.null(methods) && nrow(methods$params) > 0}
knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "<details><summary>Parameters of the run (", nrow(methods$params), ")</summary>

",
  paste(knitr::kable(methods$params, col.names = c("Parameter", "Value"), row.names = FALSE),
        collapse = "
"),
  "

</details>"
))
```

```{r no-methods, eval = !multi && is.null(methods)}
knitr::asis_output("_No run information found (manifest.json or run_info.txt)._")
```
